system.description: Spend Acclaim to execute a finisher: 1 Acclaim — Clash (weapon attack ×2 damage); 2 Acclaim — Whirlwind (attack all enemies in reach); 3 Acclaim — Pile Driver (attack + inflict Shaken); 4 Acclaim — Body Slam (attack + target cannot leave the scene for one round); 5 Acclaim — Showstopper (attack ×3 damage, all enemies in scene take 5 damage).
